scientific_integrity: Exact algebraic proof and uniform rational stability bounds; separate reproducible numerical checks corroborate but do not certify infinite cases. The homogeneous sink pair is prior knowledge and is not claimed as a novel individual fact.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the exact source parameter corner, antisymmetric spatial period-two fixed states, full real state space and local hyperbolic attraction. Other equilibria, periodic dynamics and basin measures are not classified. Historical priority is provisional; independent audit not performed.
title: Four coexisting hyperbolic sinks and the complete checkerboard census in a Gumowski–Mira ring
